_notes: Scene Machine model allowlist. Ships in the single image; the backend loads it like actions.json; the UI can fetch it via GET /definitions/models.json.
Underscore keys are documentation: ignored by loader, validator, and tests.
defaults: the default model per family, used when a caller does not pick one.

actions: one entry per model-parameterized action in actions.json. location_param is the node parameter carrying the model location (null = no location param; the worker runs it at a hardcoded region). default_key is the config field the UI resolver reads its default from.

models: keyed by exact Vertex model ID. locations must cover every location the UI, config.template.txt, and workflow_examples submit. capabilities carries ONLY flags code branches on, keyed per family. Values marked UNVERIFIED still need confirming against the model docs.

release_date / retirement_date (from the model-versions lifecycle table, YYYY-MM-DD). retirement_date is the earliest date the model may be retired ('Not before ...' in the table); null = no date announced, a short-term model, or not in the table.

gemini-3.5-flash._notes: Template default GEMINI_MODEL (config.template.txt:19), GEMINI_REGION=global. describe_image/analyse_file carry no location param (the worker runs them at a hardcoded region), so their (model, location) pair check is vacuous.

gemini-3.1-pro-preview._notes: Gemini 3.1 Pro (preview). Not in the GA lifecycle table -- preview models retire 45 days after their GA replacement. Location global verified callable on Vertex (2026-07-06); capabilities UNVERIFIED.

gemini-3.1-flash-lite._notes: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite. Location global verified callable on Vertex (2026-07-06); capabilities UNVERIFIED -- confirm against the model docs.

veo-3.1-generate-001._notes: Template default VEO_MODEL (config.template.txt:26), VEO_REGION=global. us-central1 required: workflow_examples submit gcp_location=us-central1. No retirement date announced. Discrete durations, enhance-prompt lock, and 4k are UNVERIFIED for GA 3.1.

veo-3.1-fast-generate-001._notes: Used by workflow_examples (gcp_location=us-central1). No retirement date announced. Capability flags copied from veo-3.1-generate-001; UNVERIFIED.

gemini-3-pro-image._notes: Nano Banana Pro; template default IMAGE_MODEL (config.template.txt:33), IMAGE_MODEL_REGION=global. Outpaint-eligible: {2K,4K} subset of image_sizes (the outpainter always requests 2K/4K). supports_video_input UNVERIFIED.

gemini-3.1-flash-image._notes: Nano Banana 2 (non-Lite); recommended in the config.template.txt comment. Cheap-outpaint candidate (0.5K/2K/4K). Model resolves in global (verified 2026-07-06); image_sizes and supports_video_input UNVERIFIED.

gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image._notes: Nano Banana 2 Lite (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image). Short-term availability model (retires 45 days after a replacement ships), so no fixed retirement date. Model resolves in global (verified 2026-07-06). generate_image only: outpaint needs image_sizes covering 2K and 4K, UNVERIFIED here -- add outpaint_image once image_sizes is confirmed.
